Warm light gray plain studio backdrop, soft even illumination, no scene, no text, no labels, no turnaround sheet, no extra views. Design hands and arms with coherent anatomical proportions and clearly readable shoulders, elbow flexion points, slim wrists and articulated five-finger hands; bracers must not swallow the hands or prevent wrist motion. Subject: agile female anthropomorphic red fox ranger. Orange and cream face, large sharp triangular ears, mischievous determined eyes. Compact brown leather armor with a simple gold clasp, bold vermilion scarf and short waist cloth, indigo trousers, light functional bracers and wrapped boots. Slim athletic torso with modest practical armor, exaggerated readable fox head. EXACTLY THREE separate bushy orange tails with cream tips, not four: ONE curves upward behind the character's left hip; ONE curves upward behind the right hip; the THIRD curves lower toward viewer-right below the upper-right tail. This asymmetrical 1-left plus 2-right arrangement must show three distinct tail silhouettes/tips; do not duplicate or mirror the lower tail on the left. Tails stay behind hips and clear of hands. The character's identity and palette must remain recognizably based on the provided reference.
